source: Uman, Colonna-Dashwood, ..., Hendon (2016) The effect of bean origin and temperature on grinding roasted coffee. Sci. Rep. 6, 24483.
what: Four single-origin coffees ground on an EK43 (espresso setting), laser diffraction.

text_facts.fines_cutoff_definition: diameter below which 99 % of particles by number lie
text_facts.finding: Distributions are bimodal; fine particulates contribute the majority of the accessible surface area; origin and processing do not change the distribution; grinding cold narrows it.

provenance: Copied from the text and Fig. 3 caption (modes i-vi).
